title.narrative: The Biodiversity Finance Initiative - Phase II (BIOFIN Zambia)

description.narrative: The Biodiversity Finance Initiative (BIOFIN) Phase II aims to produce improved biodiversity and development outcomes and to contribute to filling the finance gap through the implementation of Biodiversity Finance Solutions (FS). Zambia currently has no green finance policy, green bonds taxonomy nor green finance tagging system, which is holding back financing for biodiversity in the country. Therefore, these are key priorities in the AWP 2024, geared towards achieving the following FS. • Finance Solution 1: Technical Assistance for Green Bond Transaction Preparation and issuance• Finance Solution 2: Mainstreaming biodiversity in the Green Finance strategy and implementation plan for the Financial Sector• Finance Solution 3: Developing a Green Finance Tagging/reporting System for the Financial Sector• Finance Solution 4: Main streaming biodiversity in the Green Finance strategy and implementation plan for the financial sector• Finance Solution 5: Main streaming biodiversity in the Green Finance strategy and implementation plan for the financial sector• Finance Solution 6: Developing a Green Finance tagging/reporting system for the Financial Sector• Outcome 7: (Phase II) Empowering financial institutions to increase the update of gender-equal nature-related financial disclosure framework at all levels of the decision-making.
